capabilities: Preview a JEX archive and its counts before writing
Convert notebooks to folders and Joplin links to vault links
Copy resources into a _resources attachment folder
Store source ID, tags and dates as note properties
Resync changed notes and audit several archives (Pro)
disambiguation: Not an exporter to Joplin; it only reads JEX archives and writes notes into the vault.
extras: Core import is free; resync and multi-archive audit need a GitHub Sponsors payment of $5 a month or $15 once. Archives are limited to 100 MiB, and HTML notes, encrypted items and note history are not imported.
problem: Notes kept in Joplin can only be exported as JEX archives, with no direct way to turn them into linked Markdown notes that keep their notebooks, tags, dates and attachments.

relations.evidence: Import a Joplin JEX archive into your vault as Markdown notes.

summary: Imports Joplin JEX archives into a vault as Markdown notes, with notebooks as folders, converted links, tags, dates and local attachments.
